idea.text: Nvidia datacenter revenue will exceed expectation next quarter

reading.summary: The case for Nvidia beating next quarter’s data-center revenue expectations is not established: the direct FY2027 revenue view is neutral, while stronger Compute & Networking is supportive but does not settle data-center sales. The key gap is a direct next-quarter data-center revenue or guidance view; 2027 capex estimates are too distant to resolve it.
